_comment: Dialog registry. Each entry references an NPC key from _npcs/npcs/registry.json and lists their Blabber dialogs.

dialogs.description: First meeting: a lost traveler arrives in Balehm and finds Sonoros waiting on the westbound train. Orientation (Balhâm, rail directions), a light branch (robber suspicion), then Sonoros's work as a rail-crossing walker.

A traveler seeking passage trades Gondarfolas a secondhand story - a man who sailed south and never returned, a search expedition now forming - for the ride. He recognizes it as Därnis's story, explains what he's read of it (and the Ensayo/Libro chronicles that disagree on the era), then traces where his own history books came from: a trader named Bracco.

A traveler arriving at the Feria del Milenio meets Nuvilo, who orients them on what the fair celebrates, explains he holds no official role there (just a visiting scholar), and describes what he writes about - historical inventors and travelers, and an unresolved puzzle about two chronicles that never agree on the same centuries.

nerkeli._comment: nuvilo_nerkeli_feria_del_milenio is a shared two-NPC eavesdrop scene with Nuvilo (see _npcs/npcs/registry.json -> nuvilo). Registered under Nerkeli's key since it's his hangar and his spawn.mcfunction is what will own the proximity check (decided 2026-07-30, same reasoning as Khaoe hosting the khaoe_farlis_* fragments). The actual proximity roll/check logic isn't built yet - see TODO.md.

dialogs.description: A traveler stops by Nerkeli's hangar at the Feria del Milenio. Branches on whether they ask about the plane and his flying (the M7 route, his freight work) or steer the talk toward the Feria itself, where Nerkeli turns out skeptical of the 'thousand years' framing and ends up explaining his duck/Daax theory.

dialogs.condition: Nuvilo (NPC) is within proximity of Nerkeli (exact radius not yet decided - see TODO.md)
dialogs.description: Eavesdrop scene by Nerkeli's hangar: Nuvilo and Nerkeli in conversation, overheard rather than started by a right-click on either.

doran._comment: Three independent dialogs, picked at random (equal odds) on interaction rather than always firing the same one - see _npcs/actions/registry.json -> _action_templates.random_dialog for the mechanism, and functions/npcs/doran/spawn.mcfunction for the wired right-click commands. trigger:right_click below is still accurate (each dialog is still started by a right-click-triggered command, just a conditionally-gated one).

dialogs.description: A visitor at the Plaza de las Culturas asks what the pavilion is about. Döran orients them on the four castle replicas (Görff, Ciudad Dragón, Salthos Cruzados, Khan Icé), then branches on whether they ask about the unfamiliar cities, the pedestals' AI-powered architectural holograms (and their energy/time-stability cost), or what 'minor' wonder means.

Döran invites a visitor to ask about any of the four castles in the Plaza. Branches per city: Salthos Cruzados (his own hometown, and its link to the legendary prince Döran and the discovery of Plathinëa), Ciudad Dragón (its growth and his wariness over the destroyed map of Salthos Cruzados), Görff (its wars and its many travelers), and Khan Icé (where he speaks with more confidence than his actual firsthand knowledge supports).

Döran muses that cultural differences are temporal as well as spatial, then branches on the oldest culture he knows (Görff, leading into the Era del Daax), a rundown of the ages he can name, what era they're currently in (the Era de la Magia), or a light tease about how poetic he sounds.

khaoe._comment: Five dialogs total, two independent gate mechanisms, both anchored on Khaoe's own spawn.mcfunction (see functions/npcs/khaoe/spawn.mcfunction) rather than a plain always-fire right-click: (1) khaoe_calendario_mecanografico / khaoe_banco_colectivo fire based on Khaoe's own live Taterzens pose (TaterzenNPCTag.Pose - STANDING vs. SITTING respectively), checked directly in spawn.mcfunction's right-click commands; (2) the three khaoe_farlis_* ambient scene fragments are a shared two-NPC conversation with Farlis (see _npcs/npcs/registry.json -> farlis) - picked at random (equal odds, functions/npcs/khaoe/roll_dialog.mcfunction, same gametime-mod-N mechanism as doran below) but ONLY when the NPC named Farlis is within 5 blocks of Khaoe, which takes priority over the pose-based pair when both conditions could apply. Registered under Khaoe's key since her spawn.mcfunction is what actually wires the trigger; Farlis's own eventual spawn.mcfunction still needs to separately decide whether right-clicking HIM also triggers this same roll (open in TODO.md, not assumed here).

dialogs.condition: Khaoe's pose is STANDING and Farlis is not within 5 blocks
dialogs.description: A traveler asks Khaoe about the Calendario Mecanográfico, a new machine inaugurated for the Feria del Milenio that displays the current year on a moving timeline. She explains it, then reflects on how no two temples in Lundria agreed on the year - and admits she came back from her trip more confused about timekeeping than when she left, unable to actually teach what she half-remembers.

dialogs.condition: Khaoe's pose is SITTING and Farlis is not within 5 blocks
dialogs.description: Sitting on a bench watching people go by, Khaoe is approached by a traveler who's heard she's from the Collective. She confirms it, explains the horizontal organization when pressed, clarifies that Farlis isn't actually a prince (just from old Terfila money), and names a few fellow Görff residents plus her closer comrades Farlis and Khaasan when asked who else is part of it.

dialogs.condition: Farlis (NPC) is within 5 blocks of Khaoe; picked 1-of-3 at random against the other two khaoe_farlis_* fragments
dialogs.description: Ambient fragment, waiting at the Castillo de Görff replica in the Plaza de las Culturas: Khaoe and Farlis on the castle's history and what it means to them now.

dialogs.condition: Farlis (NPC) is within 5 blocks of Khaoe; picked 1-of-3 at random against the other two khaoe_farlis_* fragments
dialogs.description: Ambient fragment, same waiting scene: Khaoe and Farlis reflect on how time changes things.

dialogs.condition: Farlis (NPC) is within 5 blocks of Khaoe; picked 1-of-3 at random against the other two khaoe_farlis_* fragments
dialogs.description: Ambient fragment, same waiting scene: Khaoe and Farlis waiting for Khaasan, expected to arrive by griffon.

A visitor arrives at the entrance to the Espiral de la Historia, the Feria del Milenio's first pavilion. Iläria welcomes them and branches on where they are, what the Espiral is, and who she is, before converging on an invitation to start the tour.
